strategies.name: sma_cross
strategies.doc: Trend following: long when fast SMA > slow SMA, short when below.

strategies.name: donchian_breakout
strategies.doc:
Breakout: enter on close beyond the N-bar channel, exit on the
opposite M-bar channel (M < N), turtle-style.

strategies.name: rsi_mean_reversion
strategies.doc:
Mean reversion: buy oversold / sell overbought RSI, exit when RSI
returns to the middle, or after max_hold bars. Thresholds are
symmetric: short above 100 - lower.

strategies.name: sma_trend_filter
strategies.doc: Faber (2007) timing: hold the asset while it closes above its long moving average, else flat.

strategies.name: tsmom
strategies.doc:
Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012) on one asset: long while the trailing return
(lookback, skipping the most recent `skip` bars) is positive, else flat (or short).

strategies.name: turn_of_month
strategies.doc:
Ariel (1987); McConnell & Xu (2008): equity returns cluster around the turn of the month.
Signal on the month's last trading day, held through the first `days_after` trading days.
